_comment: Emulator config for the Firestore rules tests only.
It exists so that `npm run test:rules` does not contend with the dev
stack: firebase.json puts Firestore on 8080, which npm run dev:local, the
e2e suites and every parallel agent workspace all want. The rules tests
need nothing but an empty Firestore for a few seconds, so they get their
own port and no dev lock.
project; the entry below is what makes the emulator start at all.
